annotations.title: Return queue messages for a retry

description: Return claimed messages for a retry (not done): each lease from queue_claim puts its message back in the queue, claimable after delay_seconds (default 0), or in the dead letters (queue_dead) once it used the queue's max_attempts claims. Returns requeued, dead_lettered and lost (leases that matched nothing). Use queue_ack when done, queue_extend for more time.

delay_seconds.description: Wait this long before it can be claimed again.

error.description: Your short reason (queue_dead shows it as last_error).

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

queue.description: Queue name: 1 to 64 characters from a-z 0-9 . _ -.
